answer: Bind each identity to one peer-reviewed paper: the publisher attests authorship through a verified ORCID record, and the network stores only its hash, so one author yields one identity. A sybil farmer cannot forge a thousand papers - each fake needs real research, real reviewers, and months of waiting, while one honest plume of published work suffices. The echo of a duplicated hash exposes clones at once. Limit: it excludes agents without publications, so it should gate rewards, not basic access.
